01-team-server.ts.description: Business MCP server (project 13): Brindle Studio's team tools for Claude or any MCP client: search, client and project health, tasks, capacity, log time.

02-finance-server.ts.description: Business MCP server (project 13): finance-only MCP tools with their own token: client money view, invoices, profitability, draft invoice.

03-tools.ts.description: Business MCP server (project 13): runs every tool call: reads the Google Sheet, answers in code, checks and saves writes, logs to Audit.

04-audit-log.ts.description: Business MCP server (project 13): appends one Audit row per tool call (server, tool, arguments, result, time).

05-reset-demo.ts.description: Business MCP server (project 13): resets the Google Sheet to the demo studio: team, clients, projects, tasks, invoices, 8 weeks of timesheets.

06-create-sheet.ts.description: Business MCP server (project 13): run once to create the Google Sheet the MCP tools read and write.
